name: Enterprise Fund Committee Special Meeting Agenda 1-30-2019
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  January 30, 2019 – 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West
  Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agendized items below but shall be limited to 2
  minutes per person.

  A. Update on the El Monte Operable Unit.
  B. Update on the Water Rate Study.
  C. Update on the Sewer Master Plan.
  D. Review and Recommend Award of the Professional Services Agreement
  for the Pipeline Replacement Project (CIP 014).
  E. Review and Recommend Amendment to the Professional Services
  Agreement with Project Partners.

6.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

7.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted: January 29, 2019
